items.label: Montage Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Roadmap (results briefing): general manager Stephen Kuong-Io

set.signal: Roadmap (results briefing): general manager Stephen Kuong-Io Tai said the company plans to complete engineering development this year of the sixth-sub-generation DDR5 RCD (up to 9200MT/s, 15% above the fifth sub-generation's 8000MT/s) and the third-generation MRCD/MDB (up to 16000MT/s, 25% above the second generation's 12800MT/s); its third-sub-generation RCD revenue exceeded the second sub-generation's in H2 2025. Chairman Yang Chonghe said the PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x Retimer launched and sampled to customers in January 2025 is in customer testing and validation; because server CPUs supporting PCIe 6.0 are not yet in volume production, he said the industry expects PCIe 6.0 Retimers to enter formal scale use in 2027; it has developed 32GT/s and 64GT/s SerDes IP in-house, is developing 128GT/s SerDes for PCIe 7.0 and has started Ethernet SerDes IP; it plans to start first-generation DDR6 memory-interconnect chip development this year.

items.reason: The 2027 scale-use timing is the industry's expectation as the chairman stated it, not a company forecast; hedge restored.
items.evidence: 由于支持PCIe 6.0的服务器CPU尚未规模量产，相关Retimer芯片仍处于产业导入期，行业预期2027年PCIe 6.0 Retimer芯片将进入正式的规模应用阶段

items.signal_prefix: Director and general manager Pan Zhanhua (2025 annual result

items.label: SICC results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-19-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Chairman Zong Yanmin (results briefing): more than half of t

set.signal: Chairman Zong Yanmin (results briefing): more than half of the global top-10 power-device makers are direct customers of the company (names confidential); it has no direct supply relationship with power-module and system makers such as SST suppliers, which sit further downstream. Its global 8-inch SiC substrate share is over 50%. It completed the full 12-inch range (conductive N-type, P-type and semi-insulating) and has received orders from leading customers; its P-type substrates for smart-grid / UHV DC applications are entering field testing; in micro-nano optics, strategic cooperation with leading optics customers has produced initial use in AR/VR and precision optical sensing; and in advanced packaging, he said, SiC's very high thermal conductivity lets it serve as a heat-spreading substrate or packaging material for high-power chips.

items.reason: The chairman described advanced packaging as an application SiC's thermal conductivity suits; he did not state current use there at this briefing.
items.evidence: 在先进封装领域，利用碳化硅极高的热导率，将其作为大功率芯片的散热基板或封装材料，能够有效解决高性能芯片的“热管理”难题

items.label: Zhongtian Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: H1 2026 results briefing: general manager Lu Wei said energy

set.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: general manager Lu Wei said energy-storage system shipments rose 130% year on year and new-energy overseas revenue rose 76%; power-segment overseas business grew 28%; electronic copper foil revenue rose 63% as the company developed 140μm-210μm ultra-thick foil and completed R&D testing of RTF-3 and HVLP-2 foil for AI servers and optical modules, becoming one of the main suppliers to domestic copper-clad-laminate makers; PI film shipments rose 69%; its solid-state battery pilot line finished commissioning; it launched a mid-to-long-duration liquid-cooled storage system for data centers; and 2000Nm³/h alkaline electrolysers are available for large green-hydrogen bases. It has started building the Nantong optoelectronic computing center.

items.reason: Zhongtian supplies copper foil to CCL makers; it does not make CCL.
items.evidence: 电子铜箔营收同比提升63%，跻身国内覆铜板主力供应商

items.label: Huafeng Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: General manager Liu Taiguo (H1 2026 results briefing): deman

set.signal: General manager Liu Taiguo (H1 2026 results briefing): demand for its high-speed interconnect products is strong, orders on hand are sufficient and growing, and overall capacity utilization stays high. The leading domestic AI-server core-project companies have all started technical alignment, sample supply and validation onboarding with it, and the related products will land in batch deliveries gradually from Q4 2026 into 2027. Its communications customers include mainstream AI server makers Huawei, ZTE, Inspur, xFusion and New H3C plus internet companies Alibaba and ByteDance, and in H1 the customer base expanded faster toward internet and server makers. The Alibaba project reached volume delivery in H2 2025 with more projects in development; several ByteDance projects are in development, some products are expected to start mass production in Q4 2026 and more volume delivery is expected in 2027; it has also pushed or started project cooperation with Tencent. Board secretary Jiang Daocai said the company is one of Huawei's core suppliers of high-speed backplane connectors.

items.reason: Hedge restored: the company said it has 'pushed or started' project cooperation with Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance.
items.evidence: 公司已与阿里、腾讯、字节等互联网应用客户推动或开展项目合作
